MSME Amendment Bill Introduced in Rajya Sabha for Faster Payments

The MSME Amendment Bill 2026 was introduced in the Rajya Sabha. The proposed amendments aim to ensure faster payments and provide liquidity support for small and medium-sized enterprises. Key provisions include mandatory digital invoicing and strengthened protections against delayed payments. The government intends to improve the ease of doing business and liquidity for these businesses, with accelerated dispute resolution mechanisms.
